Use the `proscada-widget` skill.

Implement one type per Svelte file in the folder matching its Toolbox category. Reuse shared props and config helpers. Preserve Svelte 5 runes, strict TypeScript, quality states and keyboard accessibility.

Update Registry, WidgetView, Properties, per-control documentation and indices. Do not claim process success from a UI event.

Run Svelte check, widget validation, docs validation and frontend build before finishing.
